name: 72-object-fit-position
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 13px; } img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 96px; margin: 6px 0 2px; } p { margin: 0 0 10px; line-height: 1.4; } .ct { object-fit: cover; object-position: left top; } .cb { object-fit: cover; object-position: right bottom; } .nl { object-fit: contain; object-position: left center; } .nr { object-fit: contain; object-position: right center; }
html:
cover / left top：覆盖后取左上方

cover / right bottom：覆盖后取右下方

contain / left center：完整显示并靠左

contain / right center：完整显示并靠右
